name: ARIN RDAP and Whois-RWS
tier_rationale: Regional Internet Registry for North America (A8 definitions: internet registries and RIRs are trusted); P003 chair rationale: 'registries are trusted'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative registry data for ARIN-administered IP and AS number resources; out-of-region resources are answered with a redirect to the responsible RIR.

rdap.title: ARIN RDAP /registry/ip/{ip}, /registry/autnum/{asn} (303 to the responsible RIR for out-of-region resources)

terms.quote: The Whois Service is to be used for Internet operational or technical research purposes, including: [...] Automated processing of abuse requests, research and tracking of abuse issues in connection with the maintenance of Whois data, and efforts to maintain accurate SWIP records; and Identifying resources used or suspected of being used for unlawful or harassing purposes.

rdap.notes: Binding council text (P003): 'Terms open (public registry data)'; per-query lookups only, no bulk harvesting (P003 cond 3). For legal's record: the same Terms of Use (effective 9 April 2014) prohibit using the Whois Service 'as part of a commercial service or product' or for marketing; V3LUM is an internal defensive tool and never resells or republishes ARIN data. Live 2026-11-26: 8.8.8.8 answers 200 in 0.2 s; 1.1.1.1 (APNIC space) answers 303 See Other to rdap.apnic.net with a body describing the whole /8 (never parsed); AS22548 answers 303 to rdap.lacnic.net, which answers 307 to rdap.registro.br. Natural-person POCs reduce to role/organisation at ingestion (P003 cond 5).

whois_rws.title: ARIN Whois-RWS /rest/ip/{ip}.json, org nets and POC searches (not used by default)

terms.quote: The Whois Service is to be used for Internet operational or technical research purposes, including: [...] Identifying resources used or suspected of being used for unlawful or harassing purposes.

whois_rws.notes: P003 cond 5: 'Whois-RWS POC lookups are off by default'. No module of this build queries whois.arin.net (RDAP covers the per-query needs); registered so a later opt-in module extends this provider instead of creating another one. POC searches return names, e-mails and phones of network administrators: keep only role/organisation contacts (LGPD minimisation).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G01-1 (P003 rdap). RDAP ttl 24 h (TTL_CLASSES); min_interval 1 s (fair use, no published quota). Other RIRs and domain registries reached through the IANA bootstrap are in _set_rdap_registries.json.
